content_zh:
此男还特别的暴力。
温暖怒了，趁着叶非墨的唇从她的脖颈移到胸口，正吻得意乱情迷之时，膝盖往上一顶，叶非墨闷哼一声。
“shit！”叶非墨万年不变的情绪的眸子带起火花。
叶非墨的气场太强了。
她完全不是对手。
温暖伸手去捡睡袍，要遮住自己的身体，叶非墨却硬是拽住她，两人一起滚到地毯上，男子强势地压住她的手脚。
温暖怒，她很想像贝克汉姆顶球一样一头撞过去，可转念一想到叶非墨的头估计会比她的头硬，她会鲜血淋漓，温暖的热血立刻被浇冷了。
“叶非墨，我要告你强奸！”温暖怒得失去理智，口不择言，一出口就悔了。
“未遂！”叶非墨面无表情地纠正她，又接着说，“你告不倒我，你的律师费也会落到我口袋。”
你还能再彪悍一点吗？
被他这么压住，姿势太过暧昧，她不着寸缕，他却衣冠楚楚，气势上本来就两个级别的，这一对比，她更觉得自己如大灰狼嘴边的小红帽。
看着叶非墨一身衣冠整齐，她想到一个词。
衣冠禽兽。
她踢一脚蛮重的，又狠又猛，防狼三式的经典招数啊，他也痛苦地闷哼了，可为什么他还是这么急切地扑上来？莫非他家小兄弟的自我恢复能力很强悍？
温暖被自己天马行空的想法震得酥了。
“别动！”他沉声喝道，温暖焉能听他的，挣扎得更厉害了，这姿势着实不雅，她还没如此大胆过，这和那天晚上可不一样，叶非墨目光一点一滴暗下来，“看来你真的很想勾引我。”
温暖瞬间不动了，浑身僵硬如死鱼。
“很好。”叶非墨满意了，却一直盯着她看，好似在她脸上搜寻着什么，又怀念着什么，他的手温柔地抚上她的脸。
温暖莫名一颤，绝对是恐惧。
气氛，暧昧。

他身上带着一种淡淡的木兰花香，不知是什么香水味，香中带着淡淡的冷，很适合他，萦绕在她鼻尖不去，他的手在她的脸上摩擦，温暖战栗中却有一种异样。
他在透过她，看谁？
叶非墨无疑是冷酷无情的，可此时，他冷冽的眸中慢慢地晕开淡淡的温柔，那是足以溺毙人的温柔，专注，灼热，呵宠，仿佛她就是他的珍宝。
他在看谁？
温暖有自知之明，绝非是她。

This man is also extremely violent.
Nuan Nuan was angry, and when Ye Feimo's lips moved from her neck to her chest, and they were kissing her in a ecstasy, he pushed his knees up, and Ye Feimo groaned.
"Shit!" Ye Feimo's eyes, which have never changed for thousands of years, sparkled with emotion.
Ye Feimo's aura was too strong.
She is no match.
Nuan Nuan reached out to pick up her nightgown to cover her body, but Ye Feimo grabbed her hard. The two rolled onto the carpet together, and the man suppressed her hands and feet forcefully.
Nuan Nuan was so angry that she wanted to hit him like Beckham heading the ball, but then she thought that Ye Feimo's head would probably be harder than hers, and she would be dripping with blood. Nuan Nuan's hot blood was immediately chilled.
"Ye Feimo, I want to sue you for rape!" Wen Nuan was so angry that he lost his mind and spoke uncontrollably. He regretted it as soon as he said it.
"Attempted!" Ye Feimo corrected her expressionlessly, and then added, "If you can't sue me, your legal fees will also fall into my pocket."
Can you be more tough?
Being pressed down by him in this way, the posture was too ambiguous. She was naked, but he was well-dressed, and his aura was already on two levels. This comparison made her feel like Little Red Riding Hood on the lips of the big bad wolf.
Looking at Ye Feimo's neatly dressed clothes, she thought of a word.
Dressed beast.
She kicked her hard, hard and fiercely, a classic three-step anti-wolf move. He groaned in pain, but why was he still so eager to pounce on her? Could it be that his little brother's self-healing ability is very strong?
Nuan Nuan was shocked by his unbridled ideas.
"Don't move!" He shouted in a deep voice. Wen Nuan could not listen to him and struggled even harder. This posture was really inelegant. She had never been so bold before. This was different from that night. Ye Feimo's eyes darkened bit by bit, "It seems you really want to seduce me."
Warmth instantly stopped moving, and his whole body was as stiff as a dead fish.
"Very good." Ye Feimo was satisfied, but kept staring at her, as if he was searching for something on her face and missing something. His hand gently touched her face.
Warmth shivered inexplicably, it was definitely fear.
The atmosphere is ambiguous.
He carried a faint fragrance of magnolia, I don't know what kind of perfume it was. There was a touch of coldness in the fragrance, which suited him very well. It lingered on the tip of her nose. His hands rubbed her face, but there was something strange in the warmth and trembling.
Who is he looking at through her?
Ye Feimo was undoubtedly ruthless, but at this moment, a touch of tenderness slowly bloomed in his cold eyes. It was tenderness, focus, heat, and pampering that could kill people, as if she were his treasure.
Who is he looking at?
Nuan Nuan is self-aware and is definitely not her.
